newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Winterthur Europe says it and Belgian Josi to ally.
newsitem.headline: Winterthur Europe says it and Belgian Josi to ally.

text.p: Winterthur Europe, a unit of Swiss insurer Winterthur Insurance Co, said on Thursday a news conference scheduled for Monday would be about a cooperation with another insurance firm.

A spokeswoman said, "it is about a cooperation with another insurer." Asked whether it would be about a merger with Belgian family-controlled insurer Josi, she said, "well, it is in all the papers, isn't it."
Belgian papers said on Thursday Josi and Winterthur Europe planned to ally their Belgian activities. Josi is 47 percent held by Belgium's Cie Benelux Paribas (Cobepa).
A spokeswoman for Josi confirmed the newspaper reports. She said details on the cooperation deal would be provided at the November 18 news conference.
At Cobepa no one was immediately avaiable for comment.
